def run(scene, robot):
    moved = scene.with_role("moved")
    if len(moved) == 2:
        a, b = moved[0], moved[1]
    else:
        a = scene.of_kind("box cutter")[0]
        b = scene.of_kind("glue bottle")[0]
    ax, ay = a.x, a.y
    bx, by = b.x, b.y
    side = max(a.w, a.d, b.w, b.d) + 2
    buf_x, buf_y = scene.free_spot(size=(side, side), clearance=3)
    robot.move(a, buf_x, buf_y)
    robot.move(scene.get(b.name), ax, ay)
    robot.move(scene.get(a.name), bx, by)
drafts.explanation: Swap the box cutter and glue bottle by moving one to a free buffer spot, then moving the other to the first's start, then moving the buffered object to the second's start.

def run(scene, robot):
    cutter = scene.get("teal box cutter")
    glue = scene.get("glue bottle")
    ax, ay = cutter.x, cutter.y
    bx, by = glue.x, glue.y
    avoid = [(ax, ay, cutter.w + 4, cutter.d + 4), (bx, by, glue.w + 4, glue.d + 4)]
    fx, fy = scene.free_spot(size=(cutter.w, cutter.d), clearance=3, avoid=avoid)
    log(f"swap {cutter.name} {ax:.1f},{ay:.1f} <-> {glue.name} {bx:.1f},{by:.1f} via {fx:.1f},{fy:.1f}")
    robot.move(cutter, fx, fy)
    robot.move(scene.get(glue.name), ax, ay)
    robot.move(scene.get(cutter.name), bx, by)
drafts.explanation: Swaps the cutter and glue bottle by moving the cutter to a free buffer spot avoiding both start positions, then moving glue to cutter's start and cutter to glue's start.
